fields.text: All dogs are loyal. No cat is a dog. Which conclusion follows?
fields.optionD: Nothing definite follows about whether cats are loyal.
fields.explanation: The premises say dogs are loyal, but they say nothing about animals that are not dogs. Cats may or may not be loyal, so no definite conclusion about cats follows.
fields.steps:
1. All dogs are loyal: dogs sit inside the group of loyal animals.
2. No cat is a dog: cats are outside the dog group.
3. Cats could still be inside or outside the loyal group.
4. So nothing definite follows about cats.
fields.hint: Being outside the dog group does not tell you whether you are outside the loyal group.
fields.whyA: A common error: 'not a dog' does not mean 'not loyal'; other animals can be loyal too.
fields.whyB: Nothing in the premises says cats are loyal.
fields.whyC: This might be true, but it does not follow from the premises.
fields.explanationTl: Sinabi lang na loyal ang dogs; walang sinabi tungkol sa hindi dogs. Kaya hindi natin alam kung loyal ang cats o hindi.
fields.stepsTl:
1. All dogs are loyal: nasa loob ng loyal group ang dogs.
2. No cat is a dog: nasa labas ng dog group ang cats.
3. Pwedeng nasa loob o labas ng loyal group ang cats.
4. Kaya walang definite na conclusion tungkol sa cats.
fields.hintTl: Ang pagiging hindi dog ay hindi nangangahulugang hindi loyal.

fields.text: Odd one out: Lion, Tiger, Elephant, Leopard
fields.explanation: Lion, tiger and leopard are big cats that eat meat; the elephant is a plant-eater and not a cat.
fields.hint: Three of these belong to the same animal family.
fields.whyA: The lion is a meat-eating big cat, like the tiger and leopard.
fields.whyB: The tiger is a meat-eating big cat, like the lion and leopard.
fields.whyD: The leopard is a meat-eating big cat, like the lion and tiger.
fields.explanationTl: Ang lion, tiger at leopard ay big cats na kumakain ng karne; ang elephant ay herbivore at hindi cat.
fields.hintTl: Tatlo sa kanila ay galing sa iisang animal family.
